title: experiment: reverse-engineering Martin D-28 #65260 back through datum reconciliation 004O
intent: Declare the isolated D-28 #65260 reverse-engineering experiment archive, including the 004K-004O datum-reconciliation chain, generated experiment artifacts, and regression tests. The change is intentionally confined to experiment scripts and experiment documentation/results and carries no production geometry or manufacturing authority.
behavior_change: Experiment-only behavior changes: adds and extends deterministic reverse-engineering calculations, generated experiment artifacts, and their tests under scripts/experiments and docs/experiments. No production runtime, CAM route, catalog geometry, manufacturing authority, or canonical specification changes.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Runs 001-004J are preserved as the historical chain; runs 004K-004O reconcile source datums, independently derive the developed rim, re-register side heights, rebuild the constructed back-surface family with a genuine boundary residual, and correct curvature/sensitivity interpretation. The PR also carries deterministic result CSV/JSON artifacts and experiment-only tests.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The reconciliation corrects previously conflated source dimensions and replaces interpretive and validation defects that remain visible in the preserved historical runs. The new runs are therefore a superseding experiment record, not duplicate copies of existing calculations.
